# ONLYOFFICE Docs: Office API — Document API

> Although a document consists of various elements, most of them are nested in each other and three main elements can be outlined: paragraph, table and block content control. All the other elements are a part of these three larger ones.

Links below point to the Markdown version of each page. This file covers one part of the [section index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/llms.txt); for the other sections of this documentation, see the [index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Document API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api.md): Although a document consists of various elements, most of them are nested in each other and three main elements can be outlined: paragraph, table and block content control. All the other elements are a part of these three larger ones.

## Api

- [Api](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api.md): The main class of the Document API. Use it to get the current document and to create document elements, such as paragraphs, tables, images, and charts.
- [Api.AddComment](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/AddComment.md): Adds a comment to the specifed document element or array of Runs.
- [Api.AutoColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/AutoColor.md): Creates an auto-color.
- [Api.CentimetersToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CentimetersToPoints.md): Converts centimeters to points.
- [Api.Color](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/Color.md): Creates an ApiColor from a universal input.
- [Api.CompareDocuments](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CompareDocuments.md): Compares the current document with another document opened via builderJS.OpenTmpFile.
- [Api.ConvertDocument](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/ConvertDocument.md): Converts a document to Markdown or HTML text.
- [Api.CreateBlipFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateBlipFill.md): Creates a blip fill to apply to the object using the selected image as the object background.
- [Api.CreateBlockLvlSdt](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateBlockLvlSdt.md): Creates a new block level container.
- [Api.CreateChart](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateChart.md): Creates a chart with the parameters specified.
- [Api.CreateCheckBoxContentControl](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateCheckBoxContentControl.md): Creates a checkbox content control.
- [Api.CreateComboBoxContentControl](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateComboBoxContentControl.md): Creates a new combo box container with the given list of options.
- [Api.CreateCustomGeometry](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateCustomGeometry.md): Creates a new custom geometry.
- [Api.CreateDatePickerContentControl](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateDatePickerContentControl.md): Creates a new date picker content control.
- [Api.CreateDropDownListContentControl](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateDropDownListContentControl.md): Creates a new drop-down list container with the given list of options.
- [Api.CreateGradientStop](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateGradientStop.md): Creates a gradient stop used for different types of gradients.
- [Api.CreateGroup](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateGroup.md): Groups an array of drawings.
- [Api.CreateHyperlink](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateHyperlink.md): Creates a new hyperlink text block to be inserted to the current paragraph or table.
- [Api.CreateImage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateImage.md): Creates an image with the parameters specified.
- [Api.CreateInlineLvlSdt](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateInlineLvlSdt.md): Creates a new inline container.
- [Api.CreateLinearGradientFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateLinearGradientFill.md): Creates a linear gradient fill to apply to the object using the selected linear gradient as the object background.
- [Api.CreateMath](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateMath.md): Creates a math equation from a linear text string. The resulting object can be inserted into a paragraph the same way as a run (e.g. via ApiParagraph#AddElement or ApiParagraph#Push).
- [Api.CreateNoFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateNoFill.md): Creates no fill and removes the fill from the element.
- [Api.CreateNumbering](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateNumbering.md): Creates an abstract multilevel numbering with a specified type.
- [Api.CreateOleObject](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateOleObject.md): Creates an OLE object with the parameters specified.
- [Api.CreateParaPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateParaPr.md): Creates the empty paragraph properties.
- [Api.CreateParagraph](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateParagraph.md): Creates a new paragraph.
- [Api.CreatePatternFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreatePatternFill.md): Creates a pattern fill to apply to the object using the selected pattern as the object background.
- [Api.CreatePictureContentControl](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreatePictureContentControl.md): Creates a new picture container.
- [Api.CreatePresetColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreatePresetColor.md): Creates a color selecting it from one of the available color presets.
- [Api.CreatePresetGeometry](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreatePresetGeometry.md): Creates a geometry using one of the available preset shapes.
- [Api.CreateRGBColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateRGBColor.md): Creates an RGB color setting the appropriate values for the red, green and blue color components.
- [Api.CreateRadialGradientFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateRadialGradientFill.md): Creates a radial gradient fill to apply to the object using the selected radial gradient as the object background.
- [Api.CreateRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateRange.md): Creates an element range.
- [Api.CreateRun](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateRun.md): Creates a new smaller text block to be inserted to the current paragraph or table.
- [Api.CreateSchemeColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateSchemeColor.md): Creates a complex color scheme selecting from one of the available schemes.
- [Api.CreateShadow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateShadow.md): Creates a shadow which can be applied to a graphic object.
- [Api.CreateShape](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateShape.md): Creates a shape with the parameters specified.
- [Api.CreateShd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateShd.md): Creates the shading which can be applied to text, a paragraph, a table or a table cell.
- [Api.CreateSolidFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateSolidFill.md): Creates a solid fill to apply to the object using a selected solid color as the object background.
- [Api.CreateStroke](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateStroke.md): Creates a stroke adding shadows to the element.
- [Api.CreateTable](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateTable.md): Creates a new table with a specified number of rows and columns.
- [Api.CreateTableCellPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateTableCellPr.md): Creates the empty table cell properties.
- [Api.CreateTablePr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateTablePr.md): Creates the empty table properties.
- [Api.CreateTableRowPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateTableRowPr.md): Creates the empty table row properties.
- [Api.CreateTableStylePr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateTableStylePr.md): Creates the empty table style properties.
- [Api.CreateTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateTextPr.md): Creates the empty text properties.
- [Api.CreateWordArt](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/CreateWordArt.md): Creates a Text Art object with the parameters specified.
- [Api.EmusToMillimeters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/EmusToMillimeters.md): Converts English Metric Units (EMUs) to millimeters.
- [Api.EmusToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/EmusToPoints.md): Converts EMUs (English Metric Units) to points.
- [Api.FromJSON](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/FromJSON.md): Converts the specified JSON object into the Document Builder object of the corresponding type.
- [Api.GetByInternalId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/GetByInternalId.md): Returns the object by it's internal ID.
- [Api.GetDocument](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/GetDocument.md): Returns the main document.
- [Api.GetFullName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/GetFullName.md): Returns the full name of the currently opened file.
- [Api.GetMailMergeReceptionsCount](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/GetMailMergeReceptionsCount.md): Returns the mail merge receptions count.
- [Api.GetMailMergeTemplateDocContent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/GetMailMergeTemplateDocContent.md): Returns the mail merge template document.
- [Api.HexColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/HexColor.md): Creates a color from a HEX string.
- [Api.InchesToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/InchesToPoints.md): Converts inches to points.
- [Api.LinesToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/LinesToPoints.md): Converts lines to points (1 line = 12 points).
- [Api.LoadMailMergeData](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/LoadMailMergeData.md): Loads data for the mail merge.
- [Api.MailMerge](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/MailMerge.md): Starts the mail merge process.
- [Api.MergeDocuments](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/MergeDocuments.md): Merges the current document with another document opened via builderJS.OpenTmpFile.
- [Api.MergeShapes](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/MergeShapes.md): Merges an array of drawings into new shapes. The resulting shapes take the formatting of the first drawing in the array.
- [Api.MillimetersToEmus](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/MillimetersToEmus.md): Converts millimeters to English Metric Units (EMUs).
- [Api.MillimetersToPixels](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/MillimetersToPixels.md): Converts millimeters to pixels.
- [Api.MillimetersToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/MillimetersToPoints.md): Converts millimeters to points.
- [Api.PicasToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/PicasToPoints.md): Converts picas to points.
- [Api.PixelsToEmus](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/PixelsToEmus.md): Converts pixels to EMUs (English Metric Units).
- [Api.PixelsToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/PixelsToPoints.md): Converts pixels to points.
- [Api.PointsToCentimeters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/PointsToCentimeters.md): Converts points to centimeters.
- [Api.PointsToEmus](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/PointsToEmus.md): Converts points to EMUs (English Metric Units).
- [Api.PointsToInches](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/PointsToInches.md): Converts points to inches.
- [Api.PointsToLines](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/PointsToLines.md): Converts points to lines (1 line = 12 points).
- [Api.PointsToMillimeters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/PointsToMillimeters.md): Converts points to millimeters.
- [Api.PointsToPicas](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/PointsToPicas.md): Converts points to picas (1 pica = 12 points).
- [Api.PointsToPixels](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/PointsToPixels.md): Converts points to pixels.
- [Api.PointsToTwips](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/PointsToTwips.md): Converts points to twips.
- [Api.RGB](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/RGB.md): Creates an RGB color from red, green and blue components.
- [Api.RGBA](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/RGBA.md): Creates an RGBA color from red, green, blue and alpha components.
- [Api.ReplaceDocumentContent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/ReplaceDocumentContent.md): Replaces the main document content with another document content.
- [Api.ReplaceTextSmart](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/ReplaceTextSmart.md): Replaces each paragraph (or text in cell) in the select with the corresponding text from an array of strings.
- [Api.Save](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/Save.md): Saves changes to the specified document.
- [Api.ThemeColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/ThemeColor.md): Creates a theme color.
- [Api.TwipsToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/TwipsToPoints.md): Converts twips to points.
- [Api.attachEvent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/attachEvent.md): Subscribes to the specified event and calls the callback function when the event fires.
- [Api.detachEvent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Api/Methods/detachEvent.md): Unsubscribes from the specified event.

## ApiBlockLvlSdt

- [ApiBlockLvlSdt](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt.md): Class representing a container for the document content.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.AddCaption](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/AddCaption.md): Adds a caption paragraph after (or before) the current content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.AddComment](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/AddComment.md): Adds a comment to the current block content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.AddElement](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/AddElement.md): Adds a paragraph or a table or a block content control to the current container.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.AddText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/AddText.md): Adds a text to the current content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.Copy](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/Copy.md): Creates a copy of a block content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/Delete.md): Removes a content control and its content.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetAlias](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetAlias.md): Returns the alias attribute for the current container.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetAllContentControls](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetAllContentControls.md): Returns a collection of content control objects in the current content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetAllDrawingObjects](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetAllDrawingObjects.md): Returns a collection of drawing objects in the current content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetAllParagraphs](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetAllParagraphs.md): Returns a collection of paragraph objects in the current content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetAllTablesOnPage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetAllTablesOnPage.md): Returns a collection of tables on a given absolute page.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetAppearance](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetAppearance.md): Gets the visualization of the content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetBackgroundColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetBackgroundColor.md): Returns the background color of the current content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetBorderColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetBorderColor.md): Returns the border color of the current content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns a type of the ApiBlockLvlSdt class.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetColor.md): Returns the tag color of the content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetContent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetContent.md): Returns the content of the current container.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetDataBinding](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetDataBinding.md): Retrieves the data binding of the content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetDataForXmlMapping](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetDataForXmlMapping.md): Returns the content control data for the XML mapping.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetDropdownList](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetDropdownList.md): Returns a list of values of the combo box / drop-down list content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetId.md): Returns a unique ID for the current content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetInternalId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetInternalId.md): Returns an internal id of the current content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetLabel](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetLabel.md): Returns the label attribute for the current container.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetLock](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetLock.md): Returns the lock type of the current container.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetParent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetParent.md): Returns the document content that contains the current content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetParentContentControl](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetParentContentControl.md): Returns a content control that contains the current content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetParentTable](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetParentTable.md): Returns a table that contains the current content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetParentTableCell](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetParentTableCell.md): Returns a table cell that contains the current content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetPlaceholderText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetPlaceholderText.md): Returns the placeholder text from the current content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetPosInParent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetPosInParent.md): Returns the content control position within its parent element.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetRange.md): Returns a Range object that represents the part of the document contained in the specified content control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.GetTag](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/GetTag.md): Returns the tag attribute for the current container.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.IsPicture](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/IsPicture.md): Checks whether the content control is a picture control.
- [ApiBlockLvlSdt.MoveCursorOutside](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiBlockLvlSdt/Methods/MoveCursorOutside.md): Places a cursor before/after the current content control.

- [ApiChart.SetSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiChart/Methods/SetSize.md): Sets the size of the object (image, shape, chart) bounding box.
- [ApiChart.SetTitle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiChart/Methods/SetTitle.md): Specifies the chart title.
- [ApiChart.SetTitleFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiChart/Methods/SetTitleFill.md): Sets the fill to the chart title.
- [ApiChart.SetTitleOutLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiChart/Methods/SetTitleOutLine.md): Sets the outline to the chart title.

- [ApiChart.SetVerAxisOrientation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiChart/Methods/SetVerAxisOrientation.md): Specifies the vertical axis orientation.
- [ApiChart.SetVerAxisTitle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiChart/Methods/SetVerAxisTitle.md): Specifies the chart vertical axis title.
- [ApiChart.SetVerPosition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiChart/Methods/SetVerPosition.md): Sets the absolute measurement for the vertical positioning of the floating object.
- [ApiChart.SetVertAxisLabelsFontSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiChart/Methods/SetVertAxisLabelsFontSize.md): Specifies font size for labels of the vertical axis.

- [ApiChart.SetWrappingStyle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiChart/Methods/SetWrappingStyle.md): Sets the wrapping type of the current object (image, shape, chart).

- [ApiContentControlListEntry](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiContentControlListEntry.md): Class representing an entry of the combo box / drop-down list content control.

- [ApiContentControlListEntry.GetValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiContentControlListEntry/Methods/GetValue.md): Returns a String that represents the value of a list item for the combo box / drop-down list content control.
- [ApiContentControlListEntry.MoveDown](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiContentControlListEntry/Methods/MoveDown.md): Moves the current item in the parent combo box / drop-down list content control down one element, so that it is after the item that originally followed it.
- [ApiContentControlListEntry.MoveUp](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiContentControlListEntry/Methods/MoveUp.md): Moves the current item in the parent combo box / drop-down list content control up one element.

- [ApiContentControlListEntry.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiContentControlListEntry/Methods/SetText.md): Sets a String that represents the display text of a list item for the combo box / drop-down list content control.
- [ApiContentControlListEntry.SetValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiContentControlListEntry/Methods/SetValue.md): Sets a String that represents the value of a list item for the combo box / drop-down list content control.

## ApiDocumentContent

- [ApiDocumentContent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDocumentContent.md): Class representing a container for paragraphs and tables.
- [ApiDocumentContent.AddElement](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/AddElement.md): Adds a paragraph or a table or a blockLvl content control using its position in the document content.
- [ApiDocumentContent.AddParagraph](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/AddParagraph.md): Creates a new paragraph and appends it to the end of the document content.
- [ApiDocumentContent.AddText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/AddText.md): Appends the specified text to the end of the document content.
- [ApiDocumentContent.GetAllCharts](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/GetAllCharts.md): Returns a collection of chart objects from the document content.
- [ApiDocumentContent.GetAllDrawingObjects](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/GetAllDrawingObjects.md): Returns a collection of drawing objects from the document content.

- [ApiDocumentContent.Push](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/Push.md): Pushes a paragraph or a table to actually add it to the document.
- [ApiDocumentContent.RemoveAllElements](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/RemoveAllElements.md): Removes all the elements from the current document or from the current document element.
- [ApiDocumentContent.RemoveElement](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/RemoveElement.md): Removes an element using the position specified.
- [ApiDocumentContent.SelectNoteReference](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/SelectNoteReference.md): Selects the reference to this footnote/endnote.
- [ApiDocumentContent.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/SetText.md): Replaces all content of the current document content object with the specified text, preserving the formatting of the first paragraph.
- [ApiDocumentContent.ToJSON](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/ToJSON.md): Converts the ApiDocumentContent object into the JSON object.

## ApiDropCap

- [ApiDropCap](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDropCap.md): Class representing a drop cap. A drop cap is a large initial letter that is split off from a paragraph into a separate framed paragraph.
- [ApiDropCap.Clear](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDropCap/Methods/Clear.md): Removes the drop cap, merging the drop cap letter back into the paragraph text.
- [ApiDropCap.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDropCap/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns the type of the ApiDropCap class.
- [ApiDropCap.GetDistanceFromText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDropCap/Methods/GetDistanceFromText.md): Returns the distance between the drop cap and the paragraph text measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
- [ApiDropCap.GetLinesToDrop](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDropCap/Methods/GetLinesToDrop.md): Returns the number of lines that the drop cap occupies.
- [ApiDropCap.GetParent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDropCap/Methods/GetParent.md): Returns the paragraph this drop cap was requested from: either the framed drop cap paragraph itself, or the paragraph that continues its text.
- [ApiDropCap.GetPosition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDropCap/Methods/GetPosition.md): Returns the drop cap type.
- [ApiDropCap.SetDistanceFromText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDropCap/Methods/SetDistanceFromText.md): Sets the distance between the drop cap and the paragraph text measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
- [ApiDropCap.SetFontFamily](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDropCap/Methods/SetFontFamily.md): Sets the font family of the drop cap letter.
- [ApiDropCap.SetLinesToDrop](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDropCap/Methods/SetLinesToDrop.md): Sets the number of lines that the drop cap occupies. The drop cap letter is resized accordingly.
- [ApiDropCap.SetPosition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiDropCap/Methods/SetPosition.md): Sets the drop cap type.

- [ApiFormBase.GetRole](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiFormBase/Methods/GetRole.md): Returns the role of the current form.

- [ApiParaPr.SetIndRight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetIndRight.md): Sets the paragraph right side indentation.
- [ApiParaPr.SetJc](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetJc.md): Sets the paragraph contents justification.
- [ApiParaPr.SetKeepLines](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetKeepLines.md): Specifies that when rendering the document using a page view, all lines of the current paragraph are maintained on a single page whenever possible.
- [ApiParaPr.SetKeepNext](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetKeepNext.md): Specifies that when rendering the document using a paginated view, the contents of the current paragraph are at least partly rendered on the same page as the following paragraph whenever possible.
- [ApiParaPr.SetLeftBorder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetLeftBorder.md): Specifies the border which will be displayed at the left side of the page around the specified paragraph.
- [ApiParaPr.SetNumPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetNumPr.md): Specifies that the current paragraph references a numbering definition instance in the current document.
- [ApiParaPr.SetOutlineLvl](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetOutlineLvl.md): Sets the outline level for the specified properties.
- [ApiParaPr.SetPageBreakBefore](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetPageBreakBefore.md): Specifies that when rendering the document using a paginated view, the contents of the current paragraph are rendered at the beginning of a new page in the document.
- [ApiParaPr.SetRightBorder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetRightBorder.md): Specifies the border which will be displayed at the right side of the page around the specified paragraph.
- [ApiParaPr.SetShd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetShd.md): Specifies the shading applied to the contents of the paragraph.
- [ApiParaPr.SetSpacingAfter](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetSpacingAfter.md): Sets the spacing after the current paragraph.
- [ApiParaPr.SetSpacingBefore](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetSpacingBefore.md): Sets the spacing before the current paragraph.
- [ApiParaPr.SetSpacingLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetSpacingLine.md): Sets the paragraph line spacing.
- [ApiParaPr.SetStyle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetStyle.md): The paragraph style base method.
- [ApiParaPr.SetTabs](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetTabs.md): Specifies a sequence of custom tab stops which will be used for any tab characters in the current paragraph.
- [ApiParaPr.SetTopBorder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetTopBorder.md): Specifies the border which will be displayed above a set of paragraphs which have the same set of paragraph border settings.
- [ApiParaPr.SetWidowControl](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/SetWidowControl.md): Specifies whether a single line of the current paragraph will be displayed on a separate page from the remaining content at display time by moving the line onto the following page.
- [ApiParaPr.ToJSON](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParaPr/Methods/ToJSON.md): Converts the ApiParaPr object into the JSON object.

- [ApiParagraph.SetIndRight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetIndRight.md): Sets the paragraph right side indentation.
- [ApiParagraph.SetItalic](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetItalic.md): Sets the italic property to the text character.
- [ApiParagraph.SetJc](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetJc.md): Sets the paragraph contents justification.
- [ApiParagraph.SetKeepLines](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetKeepLines.md): Specifies that when rendering the document using a page view, all lines of the current paragraph are maintained on a single page whenever possible.
- [ApiParagraph.SetKeepNext](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetKeepNext.md): Specifies that when rendering the document using a paginated view, the contents of the current paragraph are at least partly rendered on the same page as the following paragraph whenever possible.
- [ApiParagraph.SetLanguage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetLanguage.md): Specifies the language which will be used to check spelling and grammar (if requested) when processing the contents of the current paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetLeftBorder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetLeftBorder.md): Specifies the border which will be displayed at the left side of the page around the specified paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetNumPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetNumPr.md): Specifies that the current paragraph references a numbering definition instance in the current document.
- [ApiParagraph.SetNumbering](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetNumbering.md): Specifies that the current paragraph references the numbering definition instance in the current document.
- [ApiParagraph.SetOutlineLvl](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetOutlineLvl.md): Sets the outline level for the specified properties.
- [ApiParagraph.SetPageBreakBefore](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetPageBreakBefore.md): Specifies that when rendering the document using a paginated view, the contents of the current paragraph are rendered at the beginning of a new page in the document.
- [ApiParagraph.SetParaId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetParaId.md): Specifies a unique ID for the current paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetPosition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetPosition.md): Specifies an amount by which text is raised or lowered for this paragraph in relation to the default baseline of the surrounding non-positioned text.
- [ApiParagraph.SetReadingOrder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetReadingOrder.md): Specifies the reading order for the current paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetRightBorder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetRightBorder.md): Specifies the border which will be displayed at the right side of the page around the specified paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetSection](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetSection.md): Sets the specified section to the current paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetShd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetShd.md): Specifies the shading applied to the contents of the paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetSmallCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetSmallCaps.md): Specifies that all the small letter characters in this paragraph are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents which are two points smaller than the actual font size specified for this text.
- [ApiParagraph.SetSpacing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetSpacing.md): Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.

- [ApiParagraph.SetStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of this paragraph are displayed with a single horizontal line through the center of the line.
- [ApiParagraph.SetStyle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetStyle.md): The paragraph style base method.
- [ApiParagraph.SetTabs](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetTabs.md): Specifies a sequence of custom tab stops which will be used for any tab characters in the current paragraph.
- [ApiParagraph.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetText.md): Replaces the paragraph content with the specified text.
- [ApiParagraph.SetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetTextPr.md): Sets the paragraph text properties.
- [ApiParagraph.SetTopBorder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetTopBorder.md): Specifies the border which will be displayed above a set of paragraphs which have the same set of paragraph border settings.
- [ApiParagraph.SetUnderline](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetUnderline.md): Specifies that the contents of this paragraph are displayed along with a line appearing directly below the character (less than all the spacing above and below the characters on the line).
- [ApiParagraph.SetVertAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetVertAlign.md): Specifies the alignment which will be applied to the contents of this paragraph in relation to the default appearance of the paragraph text:
- [ApiParagraph.SetWidowControl](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetWidowControl.md): Specifies whether a single line of the current paragraph will be displayed on a separate page from the remaining content at display time by moving the line onto the following page.
- [ApiParagraph.ToHtml](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/ToHtml.md): Converts the paragraph to HTML.

## ApiPath

- [ApiPath](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath.md): Class representing a path in geometry.
- [ApiPath.ArcTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/ArcTo.md): Draws an arc from the current point using the specified width and height radii, start angle, and sweep angle.
- [ApiPath.Close](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/Close.md): Closes the current path.
- [ApiPath.CubicBezTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/CubicBezTo.md): Draws a cubic Bezier curve from the current point to the specified end point using two control points.
- [ApiPath.GetCommand](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetCommand.md): Returns a specific path command by its index.
- [ApiPath.GetCommandCount](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetCommandCount.md): Returns the number of commands for the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetCommands](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetCommands.md): Returns all commands of the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetFill.md): Returns the fill type of the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetHeight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetHeight.md): Returns the height of the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetStroke](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetStroke.md): Returns true if the current path is stroked, otherwise false.
- [ApiPath.GetWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetWidth.md): Returns the width of the current path.
- [ApiPath.LineTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/LineTo.md): Draws a line from the current point to the specified coordinates.
- [ApiPath.MoveTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/MoveTo.md): Moves the current path to the specified coordinates.
- [ApiPath.QuadBezTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/QuadBezTo.md): Draws a quadratic Bezier curve from the current point to the specified end point using a control point.
- [ApiPath.SetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetFill.md): Sets the fill type to the current path.
- [ApiPath.SetHeight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetHeight.md): Sets the height to the current path.
- [ApiPath.SetStroke](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetStroke.md): Sets whether the current path is stroked.
- [ApiPath.SetWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetWidth.md): Sets the width to the current path.

## ApiRange

- [ApiRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange.md): Class representing a continuous region in a document. Each Range object is determined by the position of the start and end characters.
- [ApiRange.AddBookmark](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/AddBookmark.md): Adds a bookmark to the specified range.
- [ApiRange.AddComment](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/AddComment.md): Adds a comment to the current range.
- [ApiRange.AddField](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/AddField.md): Adds a field to the specified range by the field instruction code.
- [ApiRange.AddHyperlink](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/AddHyperlink.md): Adds a hyperlink to the specified range.
- [ApiRange.AddText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/AddText.md): Adds a text to the specified position.
- [ApiRange.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/Delete.md): Deletes all the contents from the current range.
- [ApiRange.ExpandTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/ExpandTo.md): Returns a new range that goes beyond the specified range in any direction and spans a different range.
- [ApiRange.GetAllParagraphs](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/GetAllParagraphs.md): Returns a collection of paragraphs that represents all the paragraphs in the specified range.
- [ApiRange.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns a type of the ApiRange class.
- [ApiRange.GetEndPage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/GetEndPage.md): Returns the end page number of the current range.
- [ApiRange.GetEndPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/GetEndPos.md): Returns the end position of the current range.
- [ApiRange.GetParagraph](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/GetParagraph.md): Returns a paragraph from all the paragraphs that are in the range.
- [ApiRange.GetRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/GetRange.md): Returns a Range object that represents the document part contained in the specified range.
- [ApiRange.GetStartPage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/GetStartPage.md): Returns the start page number of the current range.
- [ApiRange.GetStartPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/GetStartPos.md): Returns the start position of the current range.
- [ApiRange.GetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/GetText.md): Returns a text from the specified range.
- [ApiRange.GetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/GetTextPr.md): Returns the merged text properties of the entire range.
- [ApiRange.IntersectWith](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/IntersectWith.md): Returns a new range as the intersection of the current range with another range.
- [ApiRange.MoveCursorToPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/MoveCursorToPos.md): Moves a cursor to a specified position of the current range object.
- [ApiRange.Select](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/Select.md): Sets the selection to the specified range.
- [ApiRange.SetBold](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetBold.md): Sets the bold property to the text character.
- [ApiRange.SetCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetCaps.md): Specifies that any lowercase characters in the current text Range are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents.
- [ApiRange.SetColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetColor.md): Sets the text color to the current text Range.
- [ApiRange.SetDoubleStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetDoubleStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed with two horizontal lines through each character displayed on the line.
- [ApiRange.SetEndPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetEndPos.md): Sets the end position of the current range object.
- [ApiRange.SetFontFamily](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetFontFamily.md): Sets all 4 font slots with the specified font family.
- [ApiRange.SetFontSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetFontSize.md): Sets the font size to the characters of the current text Range.
- [ApiRange.SetHighlight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetHighlight.md): Specifies a highlighting color which is applied as a background to the contents of the current Range.
- [ApiRange.SetItalic](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetItalic.md): Sets the italic property to the text character.
- [ApiRange.SetLanguage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetLanguage.md): Specifies the language which will be used to check spelling and grammar (if requested) when processing the contents of the current range.
- [ApiRange.SetPosition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetPosition.md): Specifies the amount by which text is raised or lowered for the current Range in relation to the default baseline of the surrounding non-positioned text.
- [ApiRange.SetShd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetShd.md): Specifies the shading applied to the contents of the current text Range.
- [ApiRange.SetSmallCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetSmallCaps.md): Specifies that all the lowercase letter characters in the current text Range are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents which are two points smaller than the actual font size specified for this text.
- [ApiRange.SetSpacing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetSpacing.md): Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.
- [ApiRange.SetStartPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetStartPos.md): Sets the start position of the current range object.
- [ApiRange.SetStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed with a single horizontal line through the range center.
- [ApiRange.SetStyle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetStyle.md): Sets the style to the current Range.
- [ApiRange.SetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetTextPr.md): Sets the text properties to the current Range.
- [ApiRange.SetUnderline](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetUnderline.md): Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed along with a line appearing directly below the character (less than all the spacing above and below the characters on the line).
- [ApiRange.SetVertAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/SetVertAlign.md): Specifies the alignment which will be applied to the Range contents in relation to the default appearance of the Range text:
- [ApiRange.ToHtml](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/ToHtml.md): Converts the range to HTML.
- [ApiRange.ToJSON](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRange/Methods/ToJSON.md): Converts the ApiRange object into the JSON object.

- [ApiRun.GetSpacing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRun/Methods/GetSpacing.md): Gets the text spacing from the current text properties measured in twentieths of a point.

- [ApiRun.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetText.md): Replaces the whole text of the current run with the specified text, keeping the run properties.

- [ApiSmartArt.ToJSON](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiSmartArt/Methods/ToJSON.md): Converts the ApiDrawing object into the JSON object.
- [ApiSmartArt.Unselect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiSmartArt/Methods/Unselect.md): Removes the current graphic object from the selection.

## ApiTable

- [ApiTable](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable.md): Class representing a table.
- [ApiTable.AddCaption](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/AddCaption.md): Adds a caption paragraph after (or before) the current table.
- [ApiTable.AddColumn](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/AddColumn.md): Adds a new column to the current table.
- [ApiTable.AddColumns](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/AddColumns.md): Adds the new columns to the current table.
- [ApiTable.AddComment](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/AddComment.md): Adds a comment to all contents of the current table.
- [ApiTable.AddElement](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/AddElement.md): Adds a paragraph or a table or a blockLvl content control using its position in the cell.
- [ApiTable.AddRow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/AddRow.md): Adds a new row to the current table.
- [ApiTable.AddRows](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/AddRows.md): Adds the new rows to the current table.
- [ApiTable.Clear](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/Clear.md): Clears the content from the table.
- [ApiTable.Copy](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/Copy.md): Creates a copy of the current table.
- [ApiTable.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/Delete.md): Deletes the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetAllCells](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetAllCells.md): Returns a collection of all cells in the table.
- [ApiTable.GetCell](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetCell.md): Returns a cell by its position.
- [ApiTable.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns a type of the ApiTable class.
- [ApiTable.GetColumnWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetColumnWidth.md): Returns the width of the specified column (by index) of the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetColumnsCount](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetColumnsCount.md): Returns a number of columns in the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetInternalId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetInternalId.md): Returns an internal ID of the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetParent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetParent.md): Returns the document content that contains the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetParentContentControl](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetParentContentControl.md): Returns a content control that contains the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetParentTable](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetParentTable.md): Returns a table that contains the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetParentTableCell](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetParentTableCell.md): Returns a table cell that contains the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetPosInParent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetPosInParent.md): Returns the table position within its parent element.
- [ApiTable.GetRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetRange.md): Returns a Range object that represents the part of the document contained in the specified table.
- [ApiTable.GetRow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetRow.md): Returns a table row by its position in the table.
- [ApiTable.GetRowsCount](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetRowsCount.md): Returns a number of rows in the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetSelectedCells](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetSelectedCells.md): Returns the selected cells of the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetSelectedColumnsCells](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetSelectedColumnsCells.md): Returns all cells from the columns that contain the currently selected cells. This method identifies which columns contain selected cells and then returns all cells in those columns, not just the selected cells themselves.
- [ApiTable.GetSelectedRows](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetSelectedRows.md): Returns all rows that contain the currently selected cells. This method identifies which rows contain selected cells and returns those complete row objects.
- [ApiTable.GetTableDescription](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetTableDescription.md): Returns the table description.
- [ApiTable.GetTableLook](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetTableLook.md): Gets table look properties
- [ApiTable.GetTableTitle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetTableTitle.md): Returns the table title (caption).
- [ApiTable.GetTables](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetTables.md): Returns an array of tables that represents all the tables nested within the specified table.
- [ApiTable.InsertInContentControl](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/InsertInContentControl.md): Wraps the current table object with a content control.
- [ApiTable.MergeCells](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/MergeCells.md): Merges an array of cells.
- [ApiTable.RemoveColumn](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/RemoveColumn.md): Removes a table column with a specified cell.
- [ApiTable.RemoveRow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/RemoveRow.md): Removes a table row with a specified cell.
- [ApiTable.ReplaceByElement](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/ReplaceByElement.md): Replaces the current table with a new element.
- [ApiTable.Search](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/Search.md): Searches for a scope of a table object.
- [ApiTable.Select](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/Select.md): Selects the current table.
- [ApiTable.SelectRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SelectRange.md): Selects a range of cells in the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetBackgroundColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetBackgroundColor.md): Sets the background color to all cells in the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetCellSpacing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetCellSpacing.md): Specifies the default table cell spacing (the spacing between adjacent cells and the edges of the table).
- [ApiTable.SetColumnWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetColumnWidth.md): Sets the width of the specified column (by index) of the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetHAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetHAlign.md): Sets the horizontal alignment to the table.
- [ApiTable.SetHeight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetHeight.md): Sets the total height of the current table, distributing it evenly among the table rows. The value is applied as a minimum height for each row, so a row can be taller if its content requires more space.
- [ApiTable.SetJc](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetJc.md): Specifies the alignment of the current table with respect to the text margins in the current section.
- [ApiTable.SetPaddings](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetPaddings.md): Sets the table paddings.
- [ApiTable.SetShd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetShd.md): Specifies the shading which is applied to the extents of the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetStyle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetStyle.md): Sets a style to the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetStyleColBandSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetStyleColBandSize.md): Specifies a number of columns which will comprise each table column band for this table style.
- [ApiTable.SetStyleRowBandSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetStyleRowBandSize.md): Specifies a number of rows which will comprise each table row band for this table style.
- [ApiTable.SetTableBorderAll](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableBorderAll.md): Specifies a border which will be displayed on all table cell borders.
- [ApiTable.SetTableBorderBottom](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableBorderBottom.md): Sets the border which will be displayed at the bottom of the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetTableBorderInsideH](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableBorderInsideH.md): Specifies the border which will be displayed on all horizontal table cell borders which are not on the outmost edge of the parent table (all horizontal borders which are not the topmost or bottommost borders).
- [ApiTable.SetTableBorderInsideV](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableBorderInsideV.md): Specifies the border which will be displayed on all vertical table cell borders which are not on the outmost edge of the parent table (all vertical borders which are not the leftmost or rightmost borders).
- [ApiTable.SetTableBorderLeft](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableBorderLeft.md): Sets the border which will be displayed on the left of the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetTableBorderRight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableBorderRight.md): Sets the border which will be displayed on the right of the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetTableBorderTop](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableBorderTop.md): Sets the border which will be displayed at the top of the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetTableCellMarginBottom](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableCellMarginBottom.md): Specifies an amount of space which will be left between the bottom extent of the cell contents and the border of all table cells within the parent table (or table row).
- [ApiTable.SetTableCellMarginLeft](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableCellMarginLeft.md): Specifies an amount of space which will be left between the left extent of the cell contents and the left border of all table cells within the parent table (or table row).
- [ApiTable.SetTableCellMarginRight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableCellMarginRight.md): Specifies an amount of space which will be left between the right extent of the cell contents and the right border of all table cells within the parent table (or table row).
- [ApiTable.SetTableCellMarginTop](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableCellMarginTop.md): Specifies an amount of space which will be left between the top extent of the cell contents and the top border of all table cells within the parent table (or table row).
- [ApiTable.SetTableDescription](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableDescription.md): Sets the table description.
- [ApiTable.SetTableInd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableInd.md): Specifies the indentation which will be added before the leading edge of the current table in the document (the left edge in the left-to-right table, and the right edge in the right-to-left table).
- [ApiTable.SetTableLayout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableLayout.md): Specifies the algorithm which will be used to lay out the contents of the current table within the document.
- [ApiTable.SetTableLook](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableLook.md): Specifies the conditional formatting components of the referenced table style (if one exists) which will be applied to the set of table rows with the current table-level property exceptions. A table style can specify up to six different optional conditional formats, for example, different formatting for the first column, which then can be applied or omitted from individual table rows in the parent table.
- [ApiTable.SetTableTitle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableTitle.md): Sets the table title (caption).
- [ApiTable.SetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTextPr.md): Applies the text settings to the entire contents of the table.
- [ApiTable.SetVAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetVAlign.md): Sets the vertical alignment to the table.
- [ApiTable.SetWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetWidth.md): Sets the preferred width to the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetWrappingStyle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetWrappingStyle.md): Sets the table wrapping style.
- [ApiTable.Split](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/Split.md): Splits the cell into a given number of rows and columns.
- [ApiTable.ToJSON](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTable/Methods/ToJSON.md): Converts the ApiTable object into the JSON object.

- [ApiTableCell.GetInternalId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/GetInternalId.md): Returns an internal id of the current table cell.

- [ApiTableCell.GetParentTable](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/GetParentTable.md): Returns a parent table of the current cell.
- [ApiTableCell.GetPrevious](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/GetPrevious.md): Returns the previous cell if exists.
- [ApiTableCell.GetRowIndex](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/GetRowIndex.md): Returns an index of the parent row.
- [ApiTableCell.GetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/GetText.md): Returns the inner text of the current table cell.
- [ApiTableCell.RemoveColumn](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/RemoveColumn.md): Removes a column containing the current cell.
- [ApiTableCell.RemoveRow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/RemoveRow.md): Removes a row containing the current cell.
- [ApiTableCell.Search](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/Search.md): Searches for a scope of a table cell object.
- [ApiTableCell.SetBackgroundColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetBackgroundColor.md): Sets the background color to the current table cell.
- [ApiTableCell.SetCellBorderBottom](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetCellBorderBottom.md): Sets the border which will be displayed at the bottom of the current table cell.
