- [ApiTableCell.SetCellBorderRight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetCellBorderRight.md): Sets the border which will be displayed to the right of the current table cell.
- [ApiTableCell.SetCellBorderTop](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetCellBorderTop.md): Sets the border which will be displayed at the top of the current table cell.
- [ApiTableCell.SetCellMarginBottom](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetCellMarginBottom.md): Specifies an amount of space which will be left between the bottom extent of the cell contents and the border of a specific table cell within a table.

- [ApiTableCell.SetShd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetShd.md): Specifies the shading applied to the contents of the table cell.

- [ApiTableCell.SetTextDirection](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetTextDirection.md): Specifies the direction of the text flow for this table cell.

- [ApiTableRow.GetIndex](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableRow/Methods/GetIndex.md): Returns the current row index.
- [ApiTableRow.GetInternalId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableRow/Methods/GetInternalId.md): Returns an internal id of the current table row.
- [ApiTableRow.GetNext](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableRow/Methods/GetNext.md): Returns the next row if exists.
- [ApiTableRow.GetParentTable](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableRow/Methods/GetParentTable.md): Returns the parent table of the current row.
- [ApiTableRow.GetPrevious](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableRow/Methods/GetPrevious.md): Returns the previous row if exists.
- [ApiTableRow.MergeCells](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableRow/Methods/MergeCells.md): Merges the cells in the current row.
- [ApiTableRow.Remove](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableRow/Methods/Remove.md): Removes the current table row.
- [ApiTableRow.Search](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableRow/Methods/Search.md): Searches for a scope of a table row object.
- [ApiTableRow.SetBackgroundColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableRow/Methods/SetBackgroundColor.md): Sets the background color to all cells in the current table row.
- [ApiTableRow.SetHeight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableRow/Methods/SetHeight.md): Sets the height to the current table row within the current table.
- [ApiTableRow.SetRowPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableRow/Methods/SetRowPr.md): Sets the properties to the current table row.
- [ApiTableRow.SetTableHeader](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableRow/Methods/SetTableHeader.md): Specifies that the current table row will be repeated at the top of each new page wherever this table is displayed. This gives this table row the behavior of a 'header' row on each of these pages. This element can be applied to any number of rows at the top of the table structure in order to generate multi-row table headers.
- [ApiTableRow.SetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableRow/Methods/SetTextPr.md): Sets the text properties to the current row.
- [ApiTableRow.ToJSON](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTableRow/Methods/ToJSON.md): Converts the ApiTableRowPr object into the JSON object.

- [ApiTextPr.SetCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetCaps.md): Specifies that any lowercase characters in the text run are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents.
- [ApiTextPr.SetColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetColor.md): Sets the text color to the current text run.
- [ApiTextPr.SetDoubleStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetDoubleStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of the run are displayed with two horizontal lines through each character displayed on the line.
- [ApiTextPr.SetFontFamily](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetFontFamily.md): Sets all 4 font slots with the specified font family.
- [ApiTextPr.SetFontSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetFontSize.md): Sets the font size to the characters of the current text run.
- [ApiTextPr.SetHighlight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetHighlight.md): Specifies a highlighting color which is added to the text properties and applied as a background to the contents of the current run/range/paragraph.
- [ApiTextPr.SetItalic](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetItalic.md): Sets the italic property to the text character.
- [ApiTextPr.SetLanguage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetLanguage.md): Specifies the languages which will be used to check spelling and grammar (if requested) when processing the contents of the text run.
- [ApiTextPr.SetOutLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetOutLine.md): Sets the text outline to the current text run.
- [ApiTextPr.SetPosition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetPosition.md): Specifies an amount by which text is raised or lowered for this run in relation to the default baseline of the surrounding non-positioned text.
- [ApiTextPr.SetShd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetShd.md): Specifies the shading applied to the contents of the current text run.
- [ApiTextPr.SetSmallCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetSmallCaps.md): Specifies that all the small letter characters in the text run are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents which are two points smaller than the actual font size specified for this text.
- [ApiTextPr.SetSpacing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetSpacing.md): Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.
- [ApiTextPr.SetStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of the run are displayed with a single horizontal line through the center of the line.
- [ApiTextPr.SetStyle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetStyle.md): The text style base method.
- [ApiTextPr.SetTextFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetTextFill.md): Sets the text fill to the current text run.
- [ApiTextPr.SetUnderline](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetUnderline.md): Specifies that the contents of the run are displayed along with a line appearing directly below the character (less than all the spacing above and below the characters on the line).
- [ApiTextPr.SetVertAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetVertAlign.md): Specifies the alignment which will be applied to the contents of the run in relation to the default appearance of the run text:
- [ApiTextPr.ToJSON](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/ToJSON.md): Converts the ApiTextPr object into the JSON object.

- [WatermarkType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/WatermarkType.md): The watermark type.
- [XmlMapping](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/XmlMapping.md): This element specifies the information which shall be used to establish a mapping to an XML element stored within a Custom XML.
- [bookmarkRefTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/bookmarkRefTo.md): Available values of the "bookmark" reference type:
- [byte](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/byte.md): A numeric value from 0 to 255.
- [captionRefTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/captionRefTo.md): Available values of the "equation"/"figure"/"table" reference type:
- [endnoteRefTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/endnoteRefTo.md): Available values of the "endnote" reference type:
- [footnoteRefTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/footnoteRefTo.md): Available values of the "footnote" reference type:
- [headingRefTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/headingRefTo.md): Available values of the "heading" reference type:
- [highlightColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/highlightColor.md): Available highlight colors.
- [hps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/hps.md): Half-points (2 half-points = 1 point).
- [line240](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/line240.md): 240ths of a line.
- [mm](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/mm.md): 1 millimetre equals 1/10th of a centimetre.
- [numberedRefTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/numberedRefTo.md): Available values of the "numbered" reference type:
- [percentage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/percentage.md): Value from 0 to 100.
- [pt](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/pt.md): A point.
- [pt_8](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/pt_8.md): Eighths of a point (24 eighths of a point = 3 points).
- [twips](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/document-api/Enumeration/twips.md): Twentieths of a point (equivalent to 1/1440th of an inch).
